lanes.name: Audio — new cloud-feasible commercial-safe TTS surfaced by the beyond-image swarm

models.name: Qwen3-TTS
models.commercial_notes: Apache-2.0 (Alibaba Cloud) — commercial-safe for SHIPPED character VO. NOTE: the voice-clone REFERENCE audio you supply must itself be cleared; the model license does not clear the speaker.
models.speed_note: 9 prebuilt speakers, voice design from text, ~3s voice cloning, 10 languages, emotional control.
models.cloud_note: ComfyUI-Qwen-TTS is a preinstalled pack on the Comfy Cloud supported-nodes index (loads weights on the cloud GPU, no egress) -> the best CONFIRMED commercial-safe cloud TTS path for shipped JRPG dialogue/barks; pairs with Wan2.2-S2V for lip-synced cutscenes. Contrast VibeVoice (research-license-only AND off-allowlist).
models.summary: Apache-2.0 character-VO / voice-clone model from Alibaba's Qwen team, available as the ComfyUI-Qwen-TTS pack on the Comfy Cloud allowlist -> commercial-safe NPC/cutscene voice rendered headlessly on the managed RTX-6000 GPU. 9 speakers, text-driven voice design, ~3s cloning, 10 languages, emotional control. Surfaced + cloud-confirmed by the wave-06 beyond-image study-swarm; the recommended cloud VO path over the research-licensed VibeVoice.

lanes.name: ComfyUI — Comfy Cloud platform (the allowlist + sandbox gate) + cloud-relevant nodes

extras.name: Comfy Cloud supported-nodes allowlist (THE GATE)
extras.note: CLOUD GATE: the managed RTX-6000 service runs ONLY these preinstalled packs (~90% of local workflows); you CANNOT install arbitrary registry nodes or BYO node code, and a graph referencing an unlisted node is rejected. A non-image capability is cloud-feasible iff it maps to allowlisted nodes + needs no arbitrary code/network/DB. This is the decisive axis behind the cloud_feasible column.

extras.name: Official API Nodes (Gemini/GPT in-graph LLM)
extras.note: CLOUD: yes — first-party in-graph LLM/VLM (Gemini 2.5 Pro/Flash, GPT-4.1/4o/o1/o3/o4) for prompt-gen, reasoning, logic branches, captioning. BUT prepaid-credit, no free tier, drawn from the SAME 7,400-credit pool (critic correction). Open VLM packs (Florence2/QwenVL) on the allowlist run credit-FREE on the cloud GPU — prefer them for at-volume VLM-in-the-loop QA. Local-Ollama LLM nodes (127.0.0.1:11434) are cloud-impossible and duplicate ollama-intern.

extras.name: ComfyUI-RMBG (background removal / part-segmentation)
extras.note: CLOUD: yes — dedicated cloud supported page (RMBG / BiRefNet / SAM2Segment / Body/Face/Clothes / SDMatte). Mass alpha-cutting + part-masks for dataset augmentation. LICENSE TRAP: RMBG-2.0 weights are CC BY-NC (non-commercial) — pin BiRefNet/INSPYRENET for shipped assets.

extras.name: AnimateDiff-Evolved (lighter looping FX)
extras.note: CLOUD: yes — on the allowlist. Lighter, LoRA-compatible SD1.5/SDXL motion-module animation (idle breathing, flame, water, cloth) — drive a trained canon LoRA for cheap looping 2.5D FX without standing up the 14B Wan stack. Critic find (no lane surfaced it).

extras.name: ComfyScript / ComfyUI-to-Python (client-side orchestration, MIT)
extras.note: The sanctioned way to get 'Python automation' onto Comfy Cloud — both MIT, run on YOUR machine and submit workflow JSON to the API (no server-side code-exec, so the registry eval/exec ban does not apply). Replaces the sandbox-blocked in-graph python/HTTP/DB nodes; pair with the X-API-Key API for headless batch + parameter sweeps.

extras.name: SAM3 / SeC video segmentation (NOT SAM2 on cloud)
extras.note: CLOUD: yes — the cloud lists comfyui-sam3 (SAM3 Video Segmentation) + Comfyui-SecNodes (SeC). NOTE (verifier catch): there is NO standalone SAM2 video-segmentation pack on the allowlist — SAM2 appears only as a model inside ComfyUI-RMBG. Use SAM3/SeC for clean masked character-swap on cloud.

extras.name: Comfy Cloud pricing (metered credit pool — corrects 'flat')
extras.note: Creator $35/mo = 7,400 credits, 3 concurrent jobs, 30-min/workflow cap, BYO LoRA; billed only for active GPU time (~0.266 credits/GPU-sec). Corrects the old 'flat, no per-render meter' framing — it is a metered, exhaustible pool (~7.7 GPU-hrs/mo).

extras.name: Comfy Cloud server API reference (X-API-Key, headless)
extras.note: Host cloud.comfy.org; X-API-Key; POST /api/prompt -> GET /api/job/{id}/status -> /api/view; wss /ws. The server-to-server spine the studio's comfy_cloud_bridge.py uses — ComfyUI as a headless render microservice behind Sprite Foundry / style-dataset-lab.

extras.name: Comfy Registry standards (no eval/exec, no subprocess install)
extras.note: The sandbox policy that makes in-graph arbitrary-Python, web-scraping, and external-DB nodes infeasible on the managed cloud (they stay on the local 5090). 'The use of eval and exec functions is prohibited... Runtime package installation through subprocess calls is not permitted.'

extras.name: Comfy Cloud out of beta (hardware: RTX 6000 Pro, 96GB VRAM)
extras.note: Blackwell RTX 6000 Pro, 96GB VRAM + 180GB system RAM — runs Wan 14B fp8/bf16 without GGUF; custom nodes powering '~90% of local workflows' available, growing-but-bounded (the allowlist).
